'''Eton''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with forty-one [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the seventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Asar/Legends|Asar]]. It was located within the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[7G sector/Legends|7G sector]].<ref name="sector" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eton was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Eton, in grid square G-7.<ref name="TEA" />
